ev_0005.summary: Quadrilateral ABCD (A left, D top, C bottom-right, B bottom-left) with an inscribed circle centered at O (point_05). Printed letters A, B, C, D, O bind to existing CV points with no changes. Outer sides DA, AB, BC, CD are solid; O is joined to A, B, C and D by solid straight segments (OA horizontal, OD near-vertical, OB, OC). The circle is centered at O with radius about 166 px and touches all four sides (tangent at the bottom near (280,513) on BC). No right-angle square marks were verified, so no right_angle objects or angle_marks are submitted. No dashed strokes were detected.

payload.notes: Used the program-owned CV coordinates A, B, C, D, O by name without redefining them. Scale 0.013491 cm/px from STYLE METRICS; circle radius 166 px -> 2.24 cm, centred on O. Solid quadrilateral sides AB, BC, CD, DA and solid spokes OA, OB, OC, OD. Stroke 0.8pt with round joins; circle thinner at 0.5pt. Labels use the metrics font 15.5/18.6 pt. Label placements: A left, B below-left, C right, D above, O below-right. No right-angle marks (none verified). Standalone compilation needs the program prelude that defines the five coordinates.

Only the O label placement changed: from below right to above right, still bound to coordinate (O). Above right sits between the OD stroke (near vertical) and the OC stroke (down and to the right), so it clears both. The program-owned coordinate definitions are not emitted, per the program-owned block. The circle, line widths and other labels are unchanged. Note for remeasurement: the previous source had A at y=-0.782 and B at y=-3.007, while the program-owned block lists A at y=-0.779 and B at y=-3.009; the program owns these values, so no change was made here.

Cosmetic repair only. Line width reduced from 0.8pt to 0.6pt for straight strokes; circle keeps its 0.5pt width. O dot enlarged to radius 1.8pt. O label moved to below right with xshift=1pt, yshift=-1pt, still bound to (O). Labels, circle and all other geometry unchanged. Per program-owned CV coordinates, the literal \coordinate definitions were omitted (the program inserts them). Note: the previous source's A and C/B literal values differed slightly from the program block (e.g. A y=-0.782 vs -0.779, B y=-3.007 vs -3.009); the program values were used via names, so no remeasurement was applied here.
